subject: Learning Methods
title: The Power of Analogy in Explanation
description: Learn The Power of Analogy in Explanation in one minute.

hook.text: Darwin explained natural selection by comparing it to selective breeding by farmers.

buildup.text: The Power of Analogy in Explanation sets up the method, the mechanism, and the learning tradeoff.

discovery.text: The Power of Analogy in Explanation reveals the principle that makes the learning stick.

twist.text: The Power of Analogy in Explanation shows that effective learning often feels harder in the moment.

climax.text: For every new concept, ask: what everyday thing shares the same structure? That analogy is your teaching tool.

punchline.text: Find the structure. Match it to something familiar.

quiz.question: What makes an analogy effective for teaching?
options: The two things look similar on the surface
The analogy shares deep structural similarity with the concept
It uses everyday language instead of technical terms
